question: Which is the first private train flagged off in India?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Lucknow-New Delhi Tejas Express.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Lucknow–New Delhi Tejas Express is one of** India's semi-high speed full AC Tejas Express** fleets introduced by Indian Railways connecting New **Delhi in Delhi and Lucknow Junction in Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• The train started its operations on** 4 October 2019,** on the occasion of Navaratri.
 
• This train is India's **first train operated by private operators,**__ IRCTC, a** subsidiary of Indian Railways.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**Bande Bharat Train series

 
• The** Vande Bharat Express, also known as Train 18, **is a semi-high-speed, intercity, electric multiple-unit train operated by the Indian Railways on 4 routes** as of October 2022.**
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi on **October 13 flagged off the inaugural **run of the latest (Fourth) Vande Bharat Express train at Amb Andaura railway station in Himachal Pradesh’s Una district.
 
• **Currently, the eight Vande Bharat Express Trains** are running on the following routes:

 1. New Delhi – Shri Vaishno Devi Mata, Katra

 2. New Delhi – Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh

 3. Gandhinagar Capital – Ahmedabad - Mumbai Central

 4. Amb Andaura – New Delhi

 5. Mysuru – Puratchi Thalaivar Dr MGR Chennai Central

 6. Nagpur, Maharashtra – Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh

 7. Howrah – New Jalpaiguri, West Bengal

 8. Secunderabad, Telangana – Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh
